content: 1. Are you currently employed as a healthcare worker? Please select one of the following options: Yes, No, or Do not wish to disclose. If you select Yes, please proceed with the survey. 2. What is your gender? Please select one of the following options: Male, Female, or Do not wish to disclose. 3. In which country do you currently reside? Please provide the name of the country. 4. What type of healthcare professional are you? Please select one of the following options: Physician, Registered Nurse, Physician Assistant, Advanced Practice Nurse, or Other (please specify). 5. What is your area of specialty? Please select one of the following options: Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, Surgery, Urology, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Radiology, Anesthesia, Family Medicine, Ophthalmology, or Other (please specify). 6. What is your current level of training? If you are a physician, please select one of the following options: Student, Intern, Resident, Fellow, or Attending. 7. Are you a caregiver for elderly, ill, physically disabled, or mentally disabled individuals, either paid or unpaid? Please select Yes or No. Work Hours 8. On average, how many hours do you work per week? Please provide the number. 9. On average, how many days do you work per week? Please provide the number. 10. Do you primarily work during the daytime, nighttime, or both? Please select one of the following options: Daytime, Nighttime, or Both. 11. If you selected Both, how many days per week do you work at nighttime? Please provide the number. 12. If you selected Both, how many days per week do you work during the daytime? Please provide the number. 13. What was the duration of your longest shift in the past week (in hours)? Please provide the number. 14. What was the duration of your longest shift in the past month (in hours)? Please provide the number. 15. What was the duration of your longest shift in the past year (in hours)? Please provide the number. 16. What is the duration of the longest shift you have ever worked (in hours)? Please provide the number. Sleep Habits 17. On average, how many hours do you currently sleep per day? Please provide the number. 18. On average, how many hours did you sleep per day before entering the medical profession? Please provide the number. 19. What is the longest duration you have gone without sleep for work-related reasons? Please provide the number of hours. Brief Medical History 20. Do you take any medications that can cause drowsiness, sleepiness, or syncope? Please select Yes or No. 21. Have you been diagnosed with any medical condition that can cause drowsiness, sleepiness, or syncope? Please select Yes or No. 22. Does your vision require correction (e.g., glasses or contact lenses)? Please select Yes or No. 23. Do you experience difficulty seeing at night? Please select Yes or No. Epworth Sleepiness Scale (Situational Sleepiness Assessment) 24. How likely are you to doze off or fall asleep in the following situations? Please rate each on a scale of 0 (no chance of dozing) to 3 (high chance of dozing): Sitting and reading Watching television Sitting inactive in a public place (e.g., theater or meeting) As a passenger in a car for an hour without a break Lying down to rest in the afternoon when circumstances permit Sitting and talking to someone Sitting quietly after lunch without alcohol In a car, while stopped for a few minutes in traffic Driving History 25. How do you typically commute to and from work? Please select one of the following options: Drive (car or motorcycle), Public Transportation, Bicycle, Walk, or Other (please specify). 26. How would you describe the region through which you commute? Please select one of the following options: Urban, Suburban, or Rural. 27. On average, how long is your commute to and from work (each way)? Please provide the duration in minutes. 28. How many years have you held a driver’s license? Please select one of the following options: Less than 5 years, 5–10 years, 11–15 years, 16–20 years, or More than 20 years. 29. Have you ever been involved in a motor vehicle accident prior to entering the medical profession? Please select Yes or No. 30. How many motor vehicle accidents have you been involved in? Please provide the number. 31. How many of those accidents occurred due to falling asleep or impaired driving caused by lack of sleep? Please provide the number. 32. How many of those accidents do you attribute to sleep deprivation? Please provide the number. Motor Vehicle Accident History 33. Have you ever felt drowsy or fatigued while driving after a work shift? Please select Yes or No. 34. Have you ever fallen asleep at the wheel after a work shift? Please select Yes or No. 35. Have you ever had a near accident while driving after a work shift? Please select Yes or No. 36. Have you ever been involved in an accident while driving after a work shift? Please select Yes or No. 37. Do you know any healthcare professionals who have been involved in a motor vehicle accident after a work shift? Please select Yes or No. Questions for Those with Sleep Deprivation-Related Motor Vehicle Accidents 38. What time of day did your accident occur? Please select one of the following options: Daytime or Nighttime. 39. Did your accident occur on a city road or highway? Please select one of the following options: City road or Highway. 40. How would you describe the area where the accident occurred? Please select one of the following options: Urban, Suburban, or Rural. 41. If you require vision correction, were you wearing your glasses or contact lenses at the time of the accident? Please select Yes, No, or I do not require vision correction. 42. How long was your shift immediately prior to the accident (in hours)? Please provide the number. 43. How long was your shift one day prior to the accident (in hours)? Please provide the number. 44. How long was your shift two days prior to the accident (in hours)? Please provide the number. 45. How long was your shift three days prior to the accident (in hours)? Please provide the number. 46. How many night shifts did you work during the week of the accident? Please provide the number. 47. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in a visit to the emergency room? Please select Yes or No. 48. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in hospitalization? Please select Yes or No. 49. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in admission to an intensive care unit? Please select Yes or No. 50. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in life-threatening injuries? Please select Yes or No. 51. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in injuries to others? Please select Yes or No. 52. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in a visit to the emergency room for another person? Please select Yes or No. 53. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in hospitalization for another person? Please select Yes or No. 54. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in admission to an intensive care unit for another person? Please select Yes or No. 55. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in life-threatening injuries for another person? Please select Yes or No. 56. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in any chronic, permanent, or irreversible personal injury? Please select Yes or No. 57. Did you receive any government disability compensation due to this accident? Please select Yes or No. If yes, what was the estimated amount? Please provide the amount or select Do not know/Do not wish to disclose. 58. Did the accident cause any psychological disturbance to you or your family members? Please select Yes or No. If yes, please specify: Acute stress disorder, Post-traumatic stress disorder, Anxiety, Depression, or Phobia. Institutional Policies 59. If you experienced a sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident, did you report it to your institution? Please select Yes or No. 60. Does your institution have preventative policies, programs, or benefits in place to protect its staff from driving while sleep-deprived? Please select Yes, No, or Do not know. 61. Do you feel these preventative measures are sufficient? Please select Yes or No. Future Studies 62. Would you be willing to participate in a prospective study involving a brief questionnaire before and after your work shift? Please select Yes, No, or Maybe. 63. If you selected Yes or Maybe, how long do you think a reasonable daily survey on work-related fatigue and sleep deprivation should take to complete (in minutes)? Please provide the number. 64. What type of survey would appeal to you most? Please select one of the following options: Paper-based (sent by mail), Paper-based (sent by email and printed by you), Phone application, Survey link sent by email, or Survey link sent by text message. 65. Would you be interested in being contacted with more information if such a study is initiated? Please select Yes or No.
